about: A channel name to the words that identify it, as an ordered list.
notes: Quality words, codec names and the generic words for 'channel' are dropped. Digits are kept, because `Alto Sports 2` and `Alto Sports 4` differ by one character and are different channels.
A feed qualifier takes the number after it with it: `(Hat 1)` is line one of the same channel, and reading that 1 as part of the identity refuses every correct match.

cases.name: so are the other quality words
a feed qualifier takes its number with it
a feed qualifier with no number is just dropped
the generic words for channel are dropped
a plus sign is part of a name
cases.why: `Sports+` is a different channel from `Sports`, and dropping the sign merges them.

cases.name: a name of only noise has no identifying words
an empty name has none either
